## v3.1.7 (June 10, 2026)
- Agent/Editor switch added to collapsed-sidebar titlebar; unified search icon for agent search; smoother mode switching without closing auxiliary windows.
- "Devin CLI" settings section renamed to "Devin Local"; notification for failed agent sign-in; bundled agent updated to v2026.5.26-8.
- `.devinignore` support alongside `.windsurfignore` and `.codeiumignore`.
- Settings/MCP marketplace pages scroll full panel width with centered content.
